hints.title: How do you compare distances?
hints.body: Squared distance avoids square roots and keeps comparisons exact.

hints.title: What order does the output use?
hints.body: Sort by distance, then by `x`, then by `y`, and take the first `k`.

hints.title: A heap alternative
hints.body: Keep a max-heap of size `k` while scanning, or sort once if simplicity matters.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
ordered = sort points by (x*x + y*y, x, y)
return first k of ordered
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
